messages:
sara-support: Hi team — customer @oliver reporting repeated 400s from /v1/embeddings. Says dims keep alternating between 1536 and 0 depending on client. Pasting their payload+error below.

oliver-customer: Error: 400 Bad Request
{
  "error": "embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 0"
}

oliver-customer: Request body we send: 
```json
{
  "model": "text-embedding-3-large",
  "input": ["[0.12,0.03,...]"]
}
```
(This is JS fetch from customer app — they stringified the vector before putting into list)

sara-support: Ah, looks like double-encoding — vector is a string inside the array, not a numeric array. Can someone confirm server-side error message could be clearer?

matt-engineer: Confirmed. Server currently inspects request and tries to parse arrays; if sees a string it treats length as 0 leading to that misleading dimension error. We should return 400 with a schema hint. Repro steps from my side:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"text-embedding-3-large","input":["[0.1,0.2]"]}'
```
returns same 400.

alex-sdk: Also saw similar from older SDK versions when passing a single vector without wrapping: `input: 0.12` vs `input: [0.12]` or when passing a single stringified vector. Quick fix for customer: send raw numeric arrays or single strings for text only. Example correct bodies: 
```json
{ "model": "text-embedding-3-large", "input": [[0.12,0.03,...]] }
// or for a single text input
{ "model": "text-embedding-3-large", "input": "Some text to embed" }
```

oliver-customer: Thanks — we'll patch client to stop JSON.stringify the vector. Any temporary mitigation server-side? The bug hit our batch job causing billing spikes.

matt-engineer: For short term we can add a lightweight validation that rejects string elements inside "input" with a helpful message: "invalid input element type: expected number or array, got string (maybe JSON-encoded vector)". I can push a small change to validation branch.

ci-bot: CI pipeline triggered for branch fix/embeddings-validation-206400-level1 — tests queued.

jane-ops: Also flagging billing team — raised ticket to consider refund for the malformed-batch charges while we push fix.

sara-support: Action items: 1) matt to open PR with improved schema error (ETA 2h). 2) alex to post a short note in docs + SDK quickstart warning about "do not JSON.stringify vectors". 3) ops to review billing ticket. I'll reply to customer with the short-term workaround.

oliver-customer: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Will confirm after we flip our client patch.

matt-engineer: PR open: https://git.redwood.ai/r/infra/+/1234 — adding explicit type error and unit test for string-elements-in-input.

sara-support: Closing loop once customer confirms. :thumbsup:
